newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY PARTY THREATENS REFERENDUM OVER LAND PLAN.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY PARTY THREATENS REFERENDUM OVER LAND PLAN.

text.p: Hungarian opposition party the Democratic Forum (MDF) will initiate a referendum if the government maintains its plan to allow the indirect purchase of farmland by foreigners, the party said on Monday.
The government said last week it planned to allow the purchase of farmland by Hungarian-registered companies regardless of the nationality of their owners.
Ibolya David, deputy head of the MDF fraction in the parliament told the Hungarian news agency MTI that all five opposition parties were against the planned move.
Under the constituion of Hungary, which has a population of 10.4 million, 100,000 signatures are required to call a referendum.
